rate_offered.notes: Nominal annual rate before tax as printed ('1.25%'). Row 'פיקדון ל 3 שנים': rate type 'קבועה', linkage 'צמוד למדד המחירים לצרכן', amount 'החל מ-1000 ₪', break 'אין אפשרות לשבירת הפיקדון', renewal '-' / '-', exit points 'קיימת' 'מ 25 חודש ובכל יום בהמשך לפי תנאי העסקה', common-deposit rate '-', remark '-', deposit method '-'. The table prints no deposit channel. This row as printed: 'החל מ-1000 ₪': '1.25%'. Read 2026-11-09 from the data the page loads (https://www.bankhapoalim.co.il/forms/he/_api/deposit-products-data), whose message reads 'המידע נכון ל-09.11.2026 ולפני חישוב מס במקור'.

source.title: פקודת מס הכנסה [נוסח חדש], נוסח רשות המסים, עמ' 204, סעיף 125ג(ב); עמ' 41, סעיף 9(13)

tax_bucket.notes: Read as fully linked to the consumer price index on the 447 table's linkage column alone (quoted in the notes of rate_offered); no terms document of this deposit was read for its linkage, so whether the linkage is full, which the bucket needs (TXI-04: a deposit counts as linked only when fully linked to the index), rests on that column. Fully linked: the linkage differentials are exempt (TXI-05) and the interest above the linkage is taxed at up to 25% (TXI-02), at a lower bracket from age 60 (TXI-19). Copied from the rule base (sources read there 2026-10-25), not re-read today. The engine reads no tax_bucket today.
